source_evidence: However, like all classes, no-load classes still have ongoing operating costs, such as management fees, transfer agent fees and other operating expenses including, in some cases, 12b-1 fees.
question: Misconception: If a mutual fund class is no-load, it cannot charge 12b-1 fees. Is that correct?
answer: No. “No-load” means the class has no sales load; it does not mean the class has no ongoing operating costs. Some no-load classes may still have 12b-1 fees.
